content.title: The Historical Evidence for the Resurrection of Jesus Christ
content.author: Kirsopp Lake (London: Williams & Norgate; New York: G. P. Putnam's Sons, 1907; Crown Theological Library)
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: A liberal New Testament scholar's study of the resurrection narratives, best known for proposing (chapter VII) that the women went to the wrong tomb. Published 1907: public domain in the US (Lake d. 1946, so worldwide from 2017). Cited for the wrong-tomb view in its holder's own terms, not as teaching.
